## 📝 Contribute

We invite you to contribute and help improve the wiki! 💙

Here are a few ways you can get involved:

* Anyone can suggest changes or corrections to the wiki. Please read our [contribution guide](https://FreeForUs.net/other/contributing) before trying to add or remove anything.
* If you're adding a new site, please [search](https://FreeForUs.net/single-page.md) / [2](https://api.FreeForUs.net/single-page) (`Ctrl + F`) first to make sure we don't already have it.
* Approved changes will be applied to the [site](https://FreeForUs.net) and all [🔒 backups](https://github.com/FreeForUs/FreeForUs/wiki/Backups).
* You can send us stuff directly via [💬 Discord](https://github.com/FreeForUs/FreeForUs/wiki/FreeForUs-Discord).
* To help us find new sites, check out the lists of links in [site hunting](https://www.reddit.com/r/FREEMEDIAHECKYEAH/wiki/find-new-sites/).
